relations: If a base domino shifts, the stacked colorful wall above it may lose support and collapse.
When a white domino falls, it can transfer momentum to the next piece in the line.
As long as the colorful dominoes remain interlocked, the grid structure persists without external support.
If a loose domino is pushed, it slides across the floor until friction stops it.
